conviction_note: The findings sum to +1.1 and the scaled number is +0.54 (p_up 56 x abs 4.5). That is a mild lean from public evidence: 4 of 5 Polish peers beat Q3 net-profit consensus this week, mostly on provisions, and the bank itself filed no Q3 CHF-provision report after filing one for Q2. Both are proxies, the sector is already bid (5d +7.3%, banks at highs), and no guidance change is expected because the new strategy comes at year-end. The move is sized as a new-numbers print on a large, well-covered bank, above the 2.2% cadence median, which is a lower bound.

findings.finding: Four of five Polish listed banks that reported Q3 2026 this week beat PAP net-profit consensus: Alior +12.2%, ING BSK +6.4%, Millennium +6.3%, Pekao +3.0%, mBank -1%. The beats came mostly from provisions below forecast (ING -44.7%, Alior -41.3%), and NII was in line to slightly above. Erste BP beat Q2 by 11.3% on the same line (provisions -26.7% vs consensus).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 net-profit beat of +11.3% (on provisions) coincided with a +4.93% move on 30 July. The Q1 2026 in-line print had no clear reaction (the cadence-estimated date falls on another day).

findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Banks led the WIG to highs this week and EBP's 5-day run-up is +7.3%, which is what a priced sector read-through looks like. What is not priced is EBP's own provision line, which no peer print can reveal, so the residual is small.

findings.finding: Erste BP filed an Art. 17 MAR report on 29 June quantifying a 438.4m PLN pre-tax Q2 CHF legal-risk estimate change. Its current-report list through RB 36 (15 Oct) contains no equivalent for Q3, which suggests no material Q3 CHF top-up; PAP analysts also expect CHF provisions to fall sector-wide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 CHF charge was pre-announced and the Q2 print still rose +4.93% on the beat. There is no observed reaction to a quarter without a CHF report.
findings.original_quote: wpływ zmiany szacunku z tytułu ryzyka prawnego związanego z portfelem walutowych kredytów hipotecznych, na zysk II kwartału 2026 r. przed opodatkowaniem wynosi 438,4 mln złotych (RB 30/2026) [the impact of the change in estimate of CHF-mortgage legal risk on Q2 2026 pre-tax profit is 438.4m PLN]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly inside the bar: consensus already expects +27% q/q, which implies a much smaller CHF charge than Q2. What remains is the chance the charge is smaller still. The inference rests on the absence of a filing, not on a number.
findings.independence: The PAP preview says analysts expect CHF provisions to fall: https://strefainwestorow.pl/wiadomosci/20261023/wyniki-bankow-za-iii-kwartal-w-gore-na-pierwszy-ogien-millennium-alior-mbank-i

findings.finding: The KSF gave a positive opinion (30 Sep, reported 5 Oct) on cutting Erste BP's O-SII buffer from 1.50% to 1.00% of total risk exposure. That lowers the capital requirement by 50bp of TREA, and the Q3 release and call may quantify the freed surplus and the dividend capacity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction on this line for this name. The H1 dividend of 49.98 PLN per share (5.1bn PLN payout) is the reference.
findings.original_quote: wyraził pozytywną opinię w sprawie ustalenia dla Banku bufora innej instytucji o znaczeniu systemowym, w wysokości 1% łącznej kwoty ekspozycji na ryzyko [expressed a positive opinion on setting the bank's O-SII buffer at 1% of total risk exposure]
findings.why_not_priced: The buffer cut has been public since 5 Oct and is largely priced. The management's translation into a surplus or payout number is not out yet; a priced cut would show as no further reaction to a stated surplus.
findings.independence: RB 33/2026 (23 Sep), the KNF proposal at 1.00% against the current 1.50%: https://www.erste.pl/relacje-inwestorskie/raporty/raporty-lista/raport-biezacy-nr-33-2026

baseline_tension: The evidence leans mildly positive, in the same direction as the recent run-up (5d +7.3%, 60d +11.4%, while priced_lean is the run-up as a negative fade). It does not cut against the run-up, which is why p_up stays near 50 despite a peer beat pattern.
language_note: The 9-bank PAP Q3 consensus table, including Erste BP's 1,490m PLN bar and the release order, appeared only in Polish (strefainwestorow/PAP Biznes). English sources had no Q3 bar.
Peer Q3 results-vs-consensus tables (ING, Pekao, mBank, Millennium, Alior) with the provision line were in the Polish press only.
Erste BP's own ESPI current reports (RB 33-36: O-SII buffer cut, TFI closing and Q4 booking date) are Polish-language primary documents. The English search returned only Erste Group parent material.
lessons_applied: 'Right about the number, too small about the move' and 'size the move on what is new': the numbers are not pre-released, so abs_move_pct went from 3.8 to 4.5. That is above the 2.2% lower-bound cadence median and near the +4.93% Q2 reaction, kept below the 7% European new-numbers base because this is a large, 9-analyst bank with no guidance change expected.
'A beat made of a one-off is sold': confirmed the TFI gain books in Q4, so it is not part of any Q3 beat; that finding stays at +0.1.
